rules: Identity is an optional model observation until the user confirms the item batch.
Generic category does not establish kind: candles are not flashlights and loose bandages are not a complete first-aid kit.
Usable whole counts, actual access, expiry, subject scope and evidence validation apply. No clinical or household-specific kit adequacy inference.
Removing or changing a previously projected kind clears its stale legacy value; save failures publish neither ledger nor household.
Location, technique, specific care requirements, sanitation adequacy and non-water exercise consumption remain separate.
